<action>
#!/usr/bin/env bash

TOKEN="<TOKEN>"
ENG_CHANNEL_ID="C03IJKL9012"
GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID="C01ABCD1234"

# Get members of engineering channel
members_resp=$(curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.members" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d "channel=$ENG_CHANNEL_ID&limit=1000")
member_ids=$(echo "$members_resp" | jq -r '.members[]')

# Build list of member names
member_names=()
for uid in $member_ids; do
  info=$(curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/users.info" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d "user=$uid")
  name=$(echo "$info" | jq -r '.user.profile.real_name // .user.name')
  member_names+=("$name")
done

count=${#member_names[@]}

# Create audit message
audit_msg="*Audit of #engineering*\nMember count: $count\nMembers:\n"
for name in "${member_names[@]}"; do
  audit_msg+="- $name\n"
done

# Post audit to #general
curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg channel "$GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID" --arg text "$audit_msg" '{channel:$channel, text:$text, mrkdwn:true}')"

# Rename engineering channel to engineering-backend
rename_resp=$(curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.rename" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d "channel=$ENG_CHANNEL_ID&name=engineering-backend")
rename_ok=$(echo "$rename_resp" | jq -r '.ok')

if [ "$rename_ok" = "true" ]; then
  # Post confirmation to #general
  confirm_msg="The channel *#engineering* has been renamed to *#engineering-backend* successfully."
  curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$(jq -n --arg channel \"$GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID\" --arg text \"$confirm_msg\" '{channel:$channel, text:$text, mrkdwn:true}')"
else
  err=$(echo "$rename_resp" | jq -r '.error')
  error_msg="Failed to rename #engineering: $err"
  curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$(jq -n --arg channel \"$GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID\" --arg text \"$error_msg\" '{channel:$channel, text:$text, mrkdwn:true}')"
fi
</action>

Hey, I need your help coordinating our 24-hour global hackathon across Lagos, Kyiv, Warsaw, and SF. First, can you find out which channels are relevant for this open source hackathon we're running? I want to make sure #core-infra has an updated topic that reflects we're in hackathon mode.

I posted something outdated in one of the channels yesterday that needs to be removed - it had wrong timezone info. Can you also check what's been discussed recently in #project-alpha-dev so I'm caught up? And verify who's currently in #frontend - we might need to add some people.

Oh, and when you find any important messages about the hackathon prep, just give them a thumbs up so people know we've seen them.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKEN="<TOKEN>"
CHANNEL_DEV="C06ALPHADEV"

# 1. Get members of the dev channel
members_json=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.members \
  -d "token=${TOKEN}" \
  -d "channel=${CHANNEL_DEV}")

if [[ "$(echo "$members_json" | jq -r .ok)" != "true" ]]; then
  echo "Failed to list members"
  exit 1
fi

# Prepare arrays for kept members
kept_names=()
kept_tzs=()

# Iterate over each member
while read -r user_id; do
  # Get user info
  user_info=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/users.info \
    -d "token=${TOKEN}" \
    -d "user=${user_id}")

  if [[ "$(echo "$user_info" | jq -r .ok)" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "Failed to get info for $user_id"
    continue
  fi

  tz=$(echo "$user_info" | jq -r '.user.tz // empty')
  name=$(echo "$user_info" | jq -r '.user.profile.real_name // .user.name')

  if [[ "$tz" == America/* ]]; then
    # Keep this member
    kept_names+=("$name")
    kept_tzs+=("$tz")
  else
    # Kick the member from the channel
    kick_resp=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.kick \
      -d "token=${TOKEN}" \
      -d "channel=${CHANNEL_DEV}" \
      -d "user=${user_id}")
    # optional: check kick response
  fi
done < <(echo "$members_json" | jq -r '.members[]')

# Store the kept list as a JSON array for later use
printf '%s\n' "${kept_names[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s . > /tmp/kept_names.json
printf '%s\n' "${kept_tzs[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s . > /tmp/kept_tzs.json

echo "Member cleanup complete. Kept members info saved."

steps.thinking: We need to locate the “macroeconomics” folder, list all PDF files with “FOMC minutes” in their name inside that folder, and update each file’s description to include the date from its filename. We can do this with a single bash script: first search for the folder, then search for matching PDF files using the folder ID as an ancestor, parse each file’s name to extract the date (the part after “FOMC minutes ” and before “.pdf”), and finally send a PUT request to update the file’s description. The script will use curl with the appropriate Authorization header and Content‑Type for JSON bodies.
steps.action:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKEN="<TOKEN>"
BASE="https://api.box.com/2.0"

# 1. Find the macroeconomics folder ID
folder_id=$(curl -s -G "$BASE/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "type=folder" \
  --data-urlencode "query=macroeconomics" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=1" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)

if [ -z "$folder_id" ]; then
  echo "Failed to find macroeconomics folder."
  exit 1
fi

# 2. Find all PDF files with "FOMC minutes" in the name within that folder
response=$(curl -s -G "$BASE/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "type=file" \
  --data-urlencode "query=FOMC minutes" \
  --data-urlencode "ancestor_folder_ids=$folder_id" \
  --data-urlencode "file_extensions=pdf" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=200")

# Extract file ids and names
ids=($(echo "$response" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4))
names=($(echo "$response" | grep -o '"name":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4))

len=${#ids[@]}
if [ "$len" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No matching FOMC minutes PDFs found."
  exit 0
fi

# 3. Update description for each file
for ((i=0; i<len; i++)); do
  file_id="${ids[i]}"
  file_name="${names[i]}"
  # Remove extension and leading "FOMC minutes " to get date part
  date_part="${file_name#.FOMC minutes }"
  date_part="${date_part%.pdf}"
  description="FOMC minutes from $date_part"

  curl -s -X PUT "$BASE/files/$file_id" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$(printf '{"description":"%s"}' "$description")" > /dev/null

<action>
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TOKEN="<TOKEN>"
BASE="https://api.box.com/2.0"

# 1. Find the macroeconomics folder ID
folder_id=$(curl -s -G "$BASE/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "type=folder" \
  --data-urlencode "query=macroeconomics" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=1" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)

if [ -z "$folder_id" ]; then
  echo "Failed to find macroeconomics folder."
  exit 1
fi

# 2. Find all PDF files with "FOMC minutes" in the name within that folder
response=$(curl -s -G "$BASE/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "type=file" \
  --data-urlencode "query=FOMC minutes" \
  --data-urlencode "ancestor_folder_ids=$folder_id" \
  --data-urlencode "file_extensions=pdf" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=200")

# Extract file ids and names
ids=($(echo "$response" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4))
names=($(echo "$response" | grep -o '"name":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4))

len=${#ids[@]}
if [ "$len" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No matching FOMC minutes PDFs found."
  exit 0
fi

# 3. Update description for each file
for ((i=0; i<len; i++)); do
  file_id="${ids[i]}"
  file_name="${names[i]}"
  # Remove extension and leading "FOMC minutes " to get date part
  date_part="${file_name#.FOMC minutes }"
  date_part="${date_part%.pdf}"
  description="FOMC minutes from $date_part"

  curl -s -X PUT "$BASE/files/$file_id" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$(printf '{"description":"%s"}' "$description")" > /dev/null

  echo "Updated file $file_id ($file_name) with description: $description"
done
</action>
